content: .{@-अलोकः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a mythical mountain that encircles the earth and is situated beyond the sea of fresh water which surrounds the last of the seven continents; beyond लोकालोक there is complete darkness, and to this side of it there is light; it thus divides the visible world from the regions of darkness; प्रकाशश्चाप्रकाशश्च लोकालोक इवाचलः <ls>R. 1. 68</ls>; लोकालोकव्याहतं धर्मराशेः शालीनं वा धाम नालं प्रसर्तुम् <ls>Śi. 16. 83</ls>; <ls>Mv. 5. 10</ls>, <ls n="Mv. 5.">45</ls>; ऊर्ध्वमालोकयामासुः लोकालोकमिवोच्छ्रितम् <ls>Parṇāl. 3. 30</ls>; (for further explanation see <ls>Dr. Bhāṇḍārkarʼs note on {%<ab n="line">l.</ab>%} 79 of Māl. 10th Act</ls>). . ({@-कौ@}) the visible and the invisible world.
